source.name: NASA Exoplanet Archive
source.tableDescription: Planetary Systems Composite Parameters (one row per confirmed planet)
source.query: SELECT pl_name, hostname, discoverymethod, disc_year, disc_refname, pl_orbper, pl_orbperlim, pl_orbper_reflink, pl_rade, pl_radelim, pl_rade_reflink, sy_dist FROM pscomppars ORDER BY pl_name
source.citation: This research has made use of the NASA Exoplanet Archive, which is operated by the California Institute of Technology, under contract with the National Aeronautics and Space Administration under the Exoplanet Exploration Program.

statusCodes.d: derived (the archive calculated it from other values: reference "Calculated Value")
statusCodes.l: limit (archive limit flag set; direction not verified)
